primary_question_text: Does this plan provide a faithful and coherent organization of the validated SourceMap into a potential book WITHOUT inventing the book's substantive content?
coverage_note: 286/286 technical coverage does not by itself prove good editorial organization. Chapters=13; assigned=286; deferred=0; excluded=0.

title_review.title: Déjà héritiers
title_review.rationale: Condense la thèse centrale des IDEA sur la vie, la grâce et la puissance déjà données.
title_review.human_note: Editorial construct of SourceMap inherited identity / already-possessed resurrection life, love, and authority. Not a final human-approved title. French wording vs English SourceMap header is a language choice, not an unsupported promise.

title_review.title: Chair et os
title_review.rationale: Renvoie à l'exposition de la résurrection physique et au refus d'une foi seulement positionnelle.
title_review.human_note: Supported by SourceMap physical resurrection / flesh-and-bone identity topics.

title_review.title: La prière qui unit
title_review.rationale: Centre le livre sur Jean 17, colonne vertébrale du corpus.
title_review.human_note: John 17 is named in SourceMap author_intent and occupies CH006.

title_review.title: Pratiquer ce que l'on prêche
title_review.rationale: Reprend l'insistance du corpus sur la vérité prouvée par l'usage.
title_review.human_note: Matches lived-practice-over-ritual theme and IDEA040 / TOP012.

subtitle: Vie, amour et autorité déjà donnés au croyant
editorial_angle: Traiter le corpus comme un enseignement de retraite structuré : d'abord corriger ce qui a été hérité (tradition, peur, formules), puis exposer l'héritage scripturaire, puis en donner la pratique, et clore par les témoignages qui l'attestent.
target_reader: Croyants en assemblée locale, participants de retraite, ministres et pasteurs recevant un enseignement biblique accompagné de témoignages.

book_concept.purpose: Un parcours d'enseignement qui montre au croyant ce qu'il a déjà reçu en Christ — vie, amour, autorité — et comment le pratiquer au quotidien.
book_concept.core_subject: Corpus d'enseignements et de témoignages sur l'identité héritée en Christ : offices sacrés, vie de résurrection, autorité spirituelle, anatomie esprit/âme/corps, guérison et providence.
book_concept.reader_journey: Du désapprentissage des traditions héritées, à l'exposition scripturaire de la vie déjà donnée, puis à l'union avec le Père, la discipline de l'esprit et de la pensée, et enfin la pratique attestée par les témoignages.
book_concept.editorial_progression: Voir (ce que Christ a accompli) -> recevoir (union, amour, grâce) -> pratiquer (pensée, prière, imagination) -> attester (témoignages et vision).

source_theme: A multi-session teaching corpus on the believer's inherited identity in Christ, spanning sacred office, resurrection life, spiritual authority, mind/soul/spirit anatomy, and testimonies of healing, resurrection, and providence, all urging lived practice over ritual, tradition, or fear
source_author_intent: To exposit scripture (Hebrews 2, John 17, Colossians 3, Malachi, etc.) teaching believers they already possess resurrection life, unconditional love, and spiritual authority, correcting legalism, rapture-fixation, and performance-based ministry, while grounding claims in personal testimony
source_audience: Local congregations, retreat attendees, ministers and pastors receiving in-person Bible teaching and testimony
review_flags: Plan editorial language is French while SourceMap primary_language and IDEA/TOP summaries are English. Not content invention, but a human language/publication decision.
Selected title is an editorial construct, not a source fact and not a final approved title.
All 286 IDEAs ASSIGNED with 0 DEFERRED and 0 EXCLUDED: technically complete, but a human editor should confirm that small supporting retreat-logistics ideas belong in the opening chapter of a book.
notes: 286/286 technical coverage does not by itself prove good editorial organization. Chapters=13; assigned=286; deferred=0; excluded=0.
Automated EN/FR lexical overlap is not a valid invention test here. Human review compared plan framing to SourceMap theme, intent, and audience.

human_review.chapter_progression: Unlearn inherited habits (CH001) -> restored resurrection life / Hebrews 2 (CH002) -> faith vs tradition (CH003) -> sacred offices / Malachi (CH004) -> anointing without formula (CH005) -> John 17 union (CH006) -> unconditional love (CH007) -> mind set above / Colossians 3 (CH008) -> spirit/soul/body (CH009) -> training the soul (CH010) -> grace already given (CH011) -> death has no permission (CH012) -> testimonies (CH013). This is a coherent pedagogical arc matching SourceMap themes; chronological session order is not required.
human_review.coverage_quality: Important themes are represented: inherited identity, resurrection, offices, anointing, John 17, love, mind, trichotomy, practice, grace/healing, death, testimony. CH006 holds 40/286 IDEAs (~14%), under the 60% overload warning. CH001 is smallest (~2.45%) and mixes retreat posture with food/exercise supporting ideas; still above the tiny-chapter heuristic.
human_review.audience_alignment: French target_reader is a faithful rendering of SourceMap audience (local assembly / retreat / ministers and pastors receiving biblical teaching with testimony).
human_review.angle_alignment: Angle (correct inherited tradition/fear/formulas, exposé scripture, practice, close with testimony) matches author_intent (correct legalism/rapture-fixation/performance, exposé Hebrews 2 / John 17 / Colossians 3 / Malachi, ground in testimony).
human_review.uncertainty: 18 UNC assigned, 17 listed unassigned. Policy allows unassigned UNC to remain listed. No conversion of uncertainty into certainty observed in titles/purposes.
human_review.examples_references: No unknown EX/REF. Placement uses SourceMap IDs; no invented example or reference identifiers.
human_review.why_not_publication_eligible: Technical contract passed. Semantic REVIEW_REQUIRED because (1) French editorial layer on an English SourceMap needs human language approval, (2) working title is not a human-approved title, (3) all-assigned 286/286 organization should be confirmed by a human editor before freeze/publication.
